test_train_step_rng: test the train.train function verifies train step RNG state is correctly initialized and saved across training steps
test_best_checkpoint_saves_only_at_impro: test the train.evaluate function verifies best checkpoints are saved only when the evaluation metric improves
test_train_with_config: test the train.train function runs a training loop with a configurable number of steps and a checkpointer
test_evaluate_with_metric: test the train.evaluate function runs evaluation with best_model_eval_metric and checkpoint_all_hosts config options
test_experiment_rng_propagation: test that the experiment module receives and records the correct RNG shapes during training steps
